visual.name: bfusionEvmActionMatrix
visual.description: Bleed & Slip Action Matrix. Plot every project on a Cost Performance (CPI) vs Schedule Performance (SPI) matrix, with crisis / intervention quadrants, worst-offender callout, what-if crisis-threshold and overrun-cap sliders, and PMO directives.

dataRoles.name: project
dataRoles.description: One bubble per value (project, plan, or program). Supports drill-down (e.g. Portfolio > Program > Project).

dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: Optional grouping used for bubble color (e.g. Business Unit, Plan Type).

dataRoles.name: cpi
dataRoles.description: Y-axis. Cost Performance Index = EV / AC. 1.0 = on budget; <1 = over budget; >1 = under budget.

dataRoles.name: spi
dataRoles.description: X-axis. Schedule Performance Index = EV / PV. 1.0 = on schedule; <1 = behind; >1 = ahead.

dataRoles.name: size
dataRoles.description: Bubble area driver — typically EAC, BAC, or budget-at-risk. Falls back to a uniform size if not bound.

dataRoles.name: eac
dataRoles.description: Optional. Estimate-at-Completion overrun feeds the 'Portfolio EAC Overrun' header pill and the worst-offender card.

dataRoles.name: bac
dataRoles.description: Optional. Budget-at-Completion baseline. EAC - BAC = projected overrun.

dataRoles.name: tooltipFields
dataRoles.description: Extra measures to show in tooltips.

dataRoles.name: drillthrough
dataRoles.description: Fields carried when the user drills through to another page.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model.

mode.description: Surface theme for the visual chrome. Auto follows the report theme's background.

background.description: Custom mode only. Plot and root background.

surface.description: Custom mode only. Header, toolbar, panels, tiles and tooltips.

textColor.description: Custom mode only. Primary text colour.

mutedColor.description: Custom mode only. Labels, captions and axis text.

ruleColor.description: Custom mode only. Separators, tile borders and axis lines.

crisisThreshold.description: Both CPI and SPI cut-offs move together. Default 1.0 — projects below this on both axes are crisis.

overrunCap.description: Forecast overrun above this triggers the red 'Intervention Required' callout. 0 = always show.

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
